title: Are LLM Safety Judges Policy-Invariant? A Three-Principle Stress-Test
abstract: arXiv:2605.06161v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines have become the de facto evaluator for agent safety, yet existing benchmarks treat their verdicts as ground-truth proxies without checking whether the verdicts depend on the agent's behavior or merely on how the evaluation policy happens to be worded. We argue that any trustworthy safety judge must satisfy a basic property we call policy invariance, and we operationalize it as three testable principles: rubric-semantics invariance under certified-equivalent rewrites, rubric-threshold invariance under intentional strict-to-lenient shifts, and ambiguity-aware calibration so that verdict instability concentrates on genuinely ambiguous cases. Instantiating these principles as a stress-test protocol with four agent-class judges on trajectories drawn from ASSEBench and R-Judge, we surface a previously unmeasured failure mode: today's judges respond to meaningful normative shifts and to meaningless structural rewrit

translated_title: LLM安全评判者是否具有策略不变性？一项三原则压力测试
translated_abstract: LLM-as-a-Judge（以大语言模型作为评判者）流水线已成为智能体安全评估的事实标准，然而现有基准测试将评判者的判定结果视为真实标准的代理，却从未检验这些判定究竟取决于智能体的行为，还是仅仅取决于评估策略恰好采用的措辞方式。我们认为，任何可信的安全评判者都必须满足一个我们称之为“策略不变性”的基本属性，并将其操作化为三条可检验的原则：在经认证的等价改写下评分标准的语义不变性；在有意进行的由严格到宽松的阈值偏移下评分标准的阈值不变性；以及歧义感知校准，使得判定结果的不稳定性集中于真正存在歧义的案例。我们将这些原则实例化为一套压力测试协议，使用四个智能体级评判者在来自ASSEBench和R-Judge的轨迹上进行测试，揭示了一种此前未被测量过的失效模式：当今的评判者对有意义的规范变化与无意义的结构性改写……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“策略不变性”这一安全评判者必须满足的基本属性，并将其操作化为三条可检验原则构成压力测试协议，揭示了现有LLM安全评判者的判定会同时受有意义规范变化和无意义措辞改写影响这一此前未被测量的失效模式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "policy invariance" as a fundamental property for LLM safety judges, operationalizes it as three testable principles in a stress-test protocol, and reveals a previously unmeasured failure mode: current judges' verdicts respond to both meaningful normative shifts and meaningless rewording alike.
